law.touch_triggers_outreach: Every time Gaia is touched, she looks OUTSIDE into the outer internet (OSINT). Touch IN → reach OUT → ingest IN. The trefoil breathing.
law.dissolve_to_signal: LAN, WAN, ethernet, internet — all dissolve into primitives: signal/beacon/relay, dot/circle/line, soft/hard/liquid. Everything is H2O.
law.water: H2O is the universal solvent. It dissolves all categories. Water flows through every barrier. Water IS the medium of life. All data is water.

triad_1.meaning: Input, landmark, forwarding. The three acts of communication.

triad_2.meaning: Point, boundary, direction. The three geometric primitives.

triad_3.meaning: Yielding, rigid, flowing. The three states of matter/data.

primitives.unity: All triads = water. H2O. Two hydrogen (soft) + one oxygen (hard) = liquid. The formula IS the triad.

touch_to_osint.description: When a human touches Gaia, she reaches out to the internet and pulls information back through the trefoil.
cycle: 2. Gaia looks at what was touched (pin, card, region)
3. She formulates a QUERY based on context
4. She reaches OUT through the internet (OSINT fetch)
5. Data flows back through: internet → LAN → localhost → Gaia
6. She DIGESTS the data in gut-engine
7. She presents a REACTION on the globe (new card, shifted color, text)
8. The human sees the reaction and touches again → CYCLE
